These fixtures are sanitized replays of verbatim orchestrator captures in `.scratch/live-fixtures2/README-findings.txt`. Values such as IDs, titles, paths, and free-text activity are redacted; payload keys and value types are preserved.

The real `run --json` response is one stdout JSON object and writes `Using workspace ...` to stderr. `run-permission.json` preserves the early `status: permission` response. The real `send --json`, idle `wait --json`, stop, workspace-create/archive, inspect, pending-permit, deny, and stale-permit payloads are replayed here. `logs --json` is plain text despite its flag. `permit-ls.json` and `permit-pending.json` replay the captured pending-row shape: it contains no structured command/path, so description text cannot prove scope. `permit-owned-write.json` preserves the agent-controlled workspace-write description. The idle stop fixture and stale-permit error preserve the captured zero-stop and `NO_PENDING_PERMISSIONS` cases.
